relationships.subject: P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: we found the increase in tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α) level and endocytosis of surface gamma-aminobutyric acid a receptors (GABAaR) in CPSP, and these effects were inhibited by blocking P2X4R

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: antagonizing TNF-α can increase surface GABAaR expression and mechanical pain threshold

relationships.subject: TNFR1
relationships.evidence_quote: knocking down TNFR1 but not TNFR2 reversed the endocytosis of surface GABAaR and alleviated mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, the neuropathic pain was mediated, in part, through P2X4R/TNF-α/TNFR1/GABAaR signaling, which was induced after stroke.

key_findings: P2X4R blockade reduced TNF-alpha and GABAaR endocytosis in post-stroke pain rats
TNFR1 knockdown, not TNFR2, restored surface GABAaR and relieved allodynia
